name: Naturalisation (Carta de Naturalización)

requirements.blocker_text: At least 3 years of regular and continuous residence in Ecuador.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 3 years of regular, continuous legal residence.

requirements.blocker_text: Must speak and write Spanish (exemptions for university graduates educated in Spanish in Ecuador and certain applicants with disabilities).
A knowledge examination on Ecuadorian history, geography, and culture, plus an interview on motivation for naturalisation, both conducted in person (no proxies) before the MREMH.
Recognized refugees and stateless persons need only 2 years of residence, instead of the standard 3.

evidence_required.document: Apostilled/legalized birth certificate from country of origin
Proof of continuous legal residence with a permanent visa
Certificate of no criminal record from country of origin

sources.title: gob.ec (MREMH official portal) -- Naturalisation by letter (carta de naturalización): 3-year standard / 2-year refugee-stateless residence requirement, Spanish language requirement, history/geography/culture exam and interview, USD 50 + USD 350 fees, indefinite validity

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Ecuador). dual_citizenship_allowed modeled TRUE -- Ecuador imposes no renunciation requirement per the source reviewed. No marriage-based reduced-residence track exists for naturalisation in the source reviewed (unlike most European countries in this dataset) -- marriage's advantage in Ecuador is entirely at the residence stage (see ec_family_union.json's direct-to-permanent-residence grant), not a citizenship-clock reduction. Requires legal residence 'with a permanent visa' per the evidence list, meaning the 3-year (or 2-year) clock is understood here to run primarily on PERMANENT residence rather than temporary residence, though the requirements text itself says only 'regular y continua' residence without specifying visa type at the eligibility-gate level -- flagged as a minor internal ambiguity in the source, not independently resolved in this pass.
